sv.title: MTG-storägare mångmiljontankar – igen
sv.summary: MTG:s styrelseledamot Florian Schuhbauer har via bolaget Active Ownership (AOC) köpt knappt 110.000 aktier i gamingbolaget för cirka 11,5 miljoner kronor.

en.title: MTG major shareholder makes multimillion-kronor bets – again
en.summary: MTG board member Florian Schuhbauer has, through the company Active Ownership (AOC), bought just under 110,000 shares in the gaming company for approximately SEK 11.5 million.
